dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: Still back at it with the arm warmers?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: What's the point? We all know.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Why are you still hung up on me?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: I don't have time for this right now. Get out of my way.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: Have a great first day, Ayla!
